title: A saved role with Parts Department OFF hides the Parts navigation and its pages
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Parts Department OFF.
custom_steps: 1. Log in and look at the top navigation.
custom_expected:
Parts is not in the top navigation.

None of Part sales, Catalog and Inventory or Vendor and order management pages can be reached.
evidence: UI: the Technician role (no Parts Department perms) has NO Parts item in the top navigation — Parts Department OFF hides the Parts navigation.
